cases.prompt:
Map the field-level lineage of raw.customers.email into the weekly partner export.

Source: raw.customers (fields id, email, country, marketing_opt_in). Classification: email is PII-confidential. Owner: platform-data.

select c.id as customer_id,
       sha256(lower(c.email)) as email_hash,
       c.country
from {{ ref('stg_customers') }} c
where c.marketing_opt_in
